cellNote: cell = unscaled px; sheets are drawn at scale 2, so each sheet cell is cell*2 px. Sheet layout: one row per animation (rows[] lists label + frame count, frames run left to right, each frame occupies cell*2 px).

rigs.humanoid: idle/walk/attack/cast/dash × down/left/right/up, then block, hurt, death, spawn, sit, work, carry, lean (28 rows)
rigs.baked: idle/walk/attack/cast/dash × down/left/right/up, then block, hurt, death, spawn, rise (25 rows)
rigs.composite: idle, walk, attack, cast, dash, block, hurt, death, spawn, rise — down view only (10 rows); *-parts.png holds each part separately, manifest parts[] carries motion metadata (orbit/bob/chain params, speed = revolutions or cycles per 8-step loop)

regenerate: Sheets are deterministic: rebuild any actor via SpriteForge.buildSprite(cfg, theme) / sheetCanvas(cfg, theme, scale) with the cfg stored per entry. Themes: forest/autumn/dusk/winter remap all colors automatically. GIFs: workbench GIF button or SpriteGif.encode.
